title: Hieroglyphics reported at historical UFO crashes
place_text: Roswell, New Mexico; Socorro, New Mexico; Kecksburg, Pennsylvania

tellings.quote: So like you have Lonnie Zamora in ' 64. You have you know um Roswell in 47 of course you have a lot of these rumors that you know hieroglyphics are on the I think Kexsburg in ' 65 also were hieroglyphics as well.

plain: Rumours say markings like hieroglyphics were seen on the craft in several famous UFO cases: Roswell, New Mexico, in 1947, a claimed UFO crash; Socorro, New Mexico, in 1964, the case of a man named Lonnie Zamora; and, Michels thinks, Kecksburg, Pennsylvania, in 1965. Michels passes these on himself as rumours, without naming a source. If they were true, the craft would carry a written language.
